messages.sourceEnglish: Review automatic crop plans from your own growing estimates and saved buyer targets.
messages.text: Kambela maendlelo ya swibyariwa lama tiendlelaka kusuka eka mimpimo ya wena ya matirhele na swikongomelo swa vaxavi leswi hlayisiweke.

messages.sourceEnglish: Check dated nursery tray and surface needs before downloading your review.
messages.text: Kambisisa switreyi swa nersari leswi nga na masiku na swilaveko swa xitsandza u nga si kopa nkambisiso wa wena.

messages.sourceEnglish: Save your own growing estimates and review capacity and dates for measured beds.
messages.text: Hlayisa mimpimo ya wena n'wini ya matirhele u tlhela u kambela vuswikoti na masiku ya mibhedhi leyi pimiweke.

messages.sourceEnglish: Review a crop plan from your estimates
messages.text: Kambela pulani ya swibyariwa kusuka eka mimpimo ya wena

messages.sourceEnglish: Crop planner → Automatic plan from your estimates
messages.text: Mupulani wa swibyariwa → Pulani leyi tiendlelaka kusuka eka mimpimo ya wena

messages.sourceEnglish: Check your saved design, confirm availability and match buyer targets to your growing estimates. Review the proposed cycles and nursery needs; your saved sowings remain unchanged.
messages.text: Kambela dizayini ya wena leyi hlayisiweke, tiyisisa vukona u tlhela u fambisanisa swikongomelo swa vaxavi na mimpimo ya wena ya matirhele. Kambela mirhendzeleko leyi ringanyetiweke na swilaveko swa nersari; swibyariwa swa wena leswi hlayisiweke a swi cinciwi.
Kambela mimpimo ya wena ya matirhele
Mupulani wa swibyariwa → Mimpimo ya wena ya matirhele

messages.sourceEnglish: Enter your own assumptions, choose a measured bed and review the calculation. Blank values stay missing; the result is an estimate, not local farming approval.
messages.text: Nghenisa mianakanyo ya wena n'wini, hlawula mubhedhi lowu pimiweke u tlhela u kambela nhlayo. Mintsengo leyi nga hava nchumu yi tshama yi kayivela; mbuyelo i mpimo ntsena, ku nga ri mpfumelelo wa vurimi bya le ndhawini.
